edges: Section 21.02 does not require a culpable mental state, while section 6.02(b) does.

Subsection (a)(1) of Article 38.37 includes prosecution under section 21.11 of the Texas Penal Code for indecency with a child.
Acts of sexual abuse alleged in the indictment are violations of statutes that require a culpable mental state.
